title: notopleura angustissima
intro: Notopleura angustissima, commonly known as Cat's Claw Vine, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, high blood pressure, and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Notopleura angustissima include its ability to act as an immunomodulator, antimicrobial, and antiviral agent, making it a potential treatment for various infections and diseases. The bioactive constituents of Notopleura angustissima include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
